[SWS_LinIf_00313]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01579
⌈The LIN Interface shall support the Diagnostic Transport Layer (defined in the ISO
17987 specifications) without the contained Diagnostic API which represents the LIN
TP.⌋
The support of the LIN TP shall be configurable on/off to make the LIN Interface
smaller when LIN TP is not used.
